cta.body: Book a visit, ask a question or request a free estimate from our local team.

items.question: How soon can you send a plumber?
items.answer: Most planned visits can be arranged within 24-48 hours, with emergency call-outs available.

items.question: Do you provide an estimate before work starts?
items.answer: Yes. We explain the likely repair, parts and labour before beginning any paid work.

items.question: Can you repair boilers and heating systems?
items.answer: Yes, our heating specialists handle boiler servicing, pressure issues and radiator faults.

items.question: Do you cover my area?
items.answer: We cover East, North and Central London, with nearby appointments by request.

items.question: Are your engineers insured?
items.answer: Yes. Rivergate engineers are insured, trained and background checked.
